name: AI Prompt Tuning Session
description: Collaborative session for improving AI prompts, model behavior, evaluation criteria, and guardrails.

sections.title: Prompt Goal
sections.instruction: Describe the target user task, model output, audience, and constraints for the prompt

sections.title: Current Prompt / System Behavior
sections.instruction: Summarize the current prompt, model behavior, known failure modes, and examples discussed

sections.title: Test Cases
sections.instruction: List sample inputs, expected outputs, edge cases, and adversarial or ambiguous cases

sections.title: Prompt Changes Proposed
sections.instruction: Capture wording changes, instruction hierarchy changes, examples, constraints, or formatting changes proposed

sections.title: Evaluation Rubric
sections.instruction: List quality criteria, pass/fail checks, scoring rules, and unacceptable behaviors

sections.title: Safety & Guardrails
sections.instruction: Summarize safety constraints, refusal behavior, privacy concerns, and escalation rules discussed

sections.title: Iteration Plan
sections.instruction: List follow-up tests, owners, deadlines, and release or rollback considerations
